correctness.rationale: The exact forward image obstruction is equivalent to a surviving active zero run being separated from the next zero run by at least n+1 ones. Every zero run persists because r>=2, no zero runs merge, and a run still of length >=r at time n must have eroded for all preceding n steps. Conversely simultaneously extend every active output zero run n symbols rightward; the short-gap exclusion guarantees all extensions are disjoint and separated. This yields a well-defined full bi-infinite predecessor. Cyclic witnesses prove strictness, the finite labeled graph proves soficity, and arbitrarily long excluded words prove non-SFT. The included checker passed exact finite tests; it does not substitute for the universal proof.

value.rationale: An exact all-time reachability language for a natural infinite family of recently classified one-active-transition maps resolves a structural question not answered by the existing idempotence/equicontinuity theorem. The sharp predecessor horizon and strictly descending SFT-to-proper-sofic transition distinguish finite-time image complexity from infinite-time attractor complexity. It is a globally quantified classification over all bi-infinite configurations, not an isolated computational curiosity.
